Come on down to Doctor Poppy's Pet Rescue Centre and learn about the amazing animals who come to visit. Doctor Poppy is a brilliant vet who with the help of her robot friend Robbo helps any animal in need. Doctor Poppy's Pet Rescue is a fun place for poorly pets to be treated and where children can learn all about animals.

SUBSCRIBE for new videos and loads of fun!

About Moonbug: 
Moonbug Entertainment is behind some of the most popular kids’ titles in the world. Moonbug's shows include global sensations CoComelon, Blippi, Little Baby Bum, My Magic Pet Morphle, Supa Strikas, Go Buster, Playtime with Twinkle, Gecko’s Garage, ARPO and many more. Moonbug's titles are available in 27 languages on all major streaming platforms.
